title: alert_rule.missing_series_evals_to_resolve must stay BIGINT to match int64 model
answers: Why does setting missing series resolution count above 32767 fail or get truncated?
Error saving alert rule with large missing-series-evals-to-resolve value on MySQL/Postgres
How to fix SMALLINT overflow for alert rule numeric fields
Column value out of range for missing_series_evals_to_resolve
body:
Symptom: configuring missing-series resolution counts above 32767 on MySQL/Postgres fails or silently truncates because the DB column is SMALLINT while the Go model field is int64.
Root cause: pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go originally added the column as SMALLINT via AddAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve, mismatching the *int64 field on models.AlertRule/AlertRuleVersion.
Fix pattern: add a follow-up raw-SQL migration (ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve) that ALTERs the column type to BIGINT on both MySQL (MODIFY) and Postgres (ALTER COLUMN TYPE) dialects; never edit the original migration in place.
Constraints: applies whenever a Go int64 model field is backed by a narrower SQL integer type (SMALLINT/INT); migrate with a new additive migration rather than modifying history, and always widen both alert_rule and alert_rule_version columns together since they must stay schema-compatible.
applies: ngalert store/migrations when a model field's Go type is wider than its original DB column type

search: The alert_rule.missing_series_evals_to_resolve column must be BIGINT to match the int64 Go model field, preventing truncation of values above 32767 on MySQL/Postgres. The original migration incorrectly used SMALLINT; fix this with a follow-up raw-SQL migration (ExpandAlertRuleMissingSeriesEvalsToResolve) that ALTERs the column type on both database dialects. Never edit historical migrations; instead add a new additive migration and always widen both alert_rule and alert_rule_version columns together to maintain schema compatibility. Found in pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/ualert/alert_rule_missing_series_evals_to_resolve.go and pkg/services/sqlstore/migrations/migrations.go. Applies to ngalert store/migrations whenever a Go int64 field is backed by a narrower SQL integer type.
